angles.name: Coach Trust — minutes come from coach trust, not effort (ad copy Angle A)
angles.mechanism: Coaches play the kids they trust with the ball when the game is tight; trust is built in the half-second after the ball arrives (first touch + quick decision under pressure), and that is coachable.
angles.emotionalJob: Remove blame from the kid's effort; relocate the bench problem to a trainable skill.
angles.voice: Head-coach-to-parent, declarative. No emoji, no exclamation, no em dash.

angles.name: Summer Gap — a busy soccer summer is not a developmental one (ad copy Angle B)
angles.mechanism: Game volume builds game IQ, not the physical/technical separators; those need eyes on every touch. Summer (no games to win) is when players separate.
angles.emotionalJob: Reframe a 'busy summer' as a 'wasted summer' without blaming the parent's effort.
angles.voice: Head-coach-to-parent, declarative. No emoji, no exclamation, no em dash.

angles.name: Confidence — confidence is downstream of competence (ad copy Angle C)
angles.mechanism: Confidence is not a pep talk; it is a byproduct of a reliable first touch. Build the skill and belief follows.
angles.emotionalJob: Reframe confidence from an unfixable personality trait to a fixable skill outcome; warm, situation-focused, never about the child's character.
angles.voice: Head-coach-to-parent, declarative. No emoji, no exclamation, no em dash.
